description: A 1-high tunnel (x 2 to 10) entered crawling (a block appears at head height). In its ceiling at x 5 an extended piston facing up (powered by a redstone block in the wall), crawled under, retracted and extended again over the player; in its south wall at x 8 a piston facing north, which pushes the crawling player north into a gap in the north wall and retracts; then crawl back into the tunnel and out of its far end.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
